channel.title: Rag on Akshat Gupta
channel.description: Recent content in Rag on Akshat Gupta

item.title: Vector Databases: Indexes, Retrieval, and Production Trade-offs
item.description: A guide to vector search, ANN indexes, filtering, hybrid retrieval, production operations, and deciding whether a dedicated vector database is necessary.

item.title: Knowledge Graphs: Data Models, Construction, and Graph RAG
item.description: A practical guide to knowledge-graph models, identity, provenance, construction, querying, evaluation, and their role in retrieval-augmented generation.

item.title: How Do You Evaluate LLM Systems?
item.description: A production-oriented framework for evaluating LLM applications across model quality, retrieval, agent behaviour, safety, latency, and cost.

item.title: Building Reliable RAG Systems
item.description: An end-to-end guide to building and evaluating production RAG systems, from document ingestion and hybrid retrieval to grounded generation and observability.

item.title: Memory in Large Language Models
item.description: A guide to the mechanisms called LLM memory: model parameters, context, KV caches, retrieval, recurrent state, and persistent application storage.
